txs.description: Deploy BnagentMint via the CREATE2 deployer proxy (also deploys BnagentToken and creates the official, empty PancakeSwap BNAGENT/USDT pair). Mint starts PAUSED; shares #1-#1,100 are burned (sale starts at #1,101). Jager money model: 20% of each payment to the treasury, 80% held by the mint contract; the tx reaching share 10,000 automatically opens the official pool with everything parked (7,120 USDT + 356B BNAGENT), LP to dead; afterwards 80% of each mint is added to the pool (LP to dead).

Open minting: treasury calls setPaused(false) on the mint contract (only after the website shows the deployed addresses). The first unpause starts the 30-day clock: if share 10,000 is not reached by mintStartTime + 30 days, only the treasury can call withdrawUnfilled() (selector 0xa65c6326), which sends all USDT held to the treasury and closes minting for good.
